title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson
description: Comprehensive textbook covering a broad range of algorithms in depth, used worldwide in undergraduate and graduate courses.

title: Database System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth
description: Comprehensive treatment of the fundamentals of database systems, covering relational model, SQL, ER design, and more.

title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach
author: James Kurose, Keith Ross
description: Unique top-down approach to computer networking that begins with applications and works down the protocol stack.

title: Operating System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter B. Galvin
description: The definitive guide to operating systems, covering process management, memory management, storage, and security.

title: Engineering Mathematics
author: B.S. Grewal
description: Standard reference for engineering mathematics covering calculus, differential equations, and linear algebra.

title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
author: Kenneth H. Rosen
description: Accessible introduction to discrete mathematics covering logic, sets, relations, functions, graph theory, and combinatorics.

title: Concepts of Physics Vol. 1
author: H.C. Verma
description: Classic textbook for introductory physics covering mechanics, waves, and thermodynamics.

title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Software
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson
description: The seminal work on software design patterns, cataloging 23 classic patterns for object-oriented design.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A guide to writing clean, maintainable code with principles, patterns, and best practices for software development.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
description: The most comprehensive and widely used textbook on artificial intelligence, covering search, logic, learning, and more.

title: Principles of Economics
author: N. Gregory Mankiw
description: Introductory economics textbook covering microeconomic and macroeconomic principles with real-world applications.

title: The C Programming Language
author: Brian W. Kernighan, Dennis M. Ritchie
description: The authoritative reference and tutorial for the C programming language, written by the creators of C.

title: Organic Chemistry
author: Morrison & Boyd
description: A comprehensive guide to organic chemistry, covering reaction mechanisms, stereochemistry, and spectroscopy.

title: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach
author: Roger S. Pressman, Bruce R. Maxim
description: Industry-leading text on software engineering practices, covering project management, design, testing, and quality assurance.

title: Linear Algebra and Its Applications
author: Gilbert Strang
description: Clear and accessible introduction to linear algebra, connecting theory with real-world applications in engineering and science.
